component.name: Alforja
component.summary: Native GTK4/Libadwaita graphical manager for llama.cpp

description.p: Alforja is a lightweight Linux desktop application designed to control and configure local llama-server instances.

ul.li: Granular daemon lifecycle: Start, Stop, and Pause (SIGSTOP freezes execution while preserving VRAM).
Strict offline network sandbox: Runs llama-server isolated via Linux unshare namespaces.
VRAM-tuned for consumer hardware like the Nvidia GTX 1650 (Flash Attention, KV cache quantization, micro-batch tuning).
Built-in direct URL model downloader with real-time transfer stats.

description.p: Initial release of Alforja with GTK4 / Libadwaita interface, Halter controls, configuration profiles, and model downloader.
